claim: VCTRL-vs-frequency scan of the open-loop 2x VCO driving the DR-010 I/Q divide-by-2 over the ratified DR-003 PVT set (issue #422, parent #332): locates, per corner, the VCTRL that gives 25 and 50 MHz at the divider output (50 and 100 MHz VCO) for the two graded campaigns sim/vco-2x-iq-25mhz and sim/vco-2x-iq-50mhz. Frequency characterization only; ratifies nothing.
spec_rows_note: Frequency scan feeding the DR-010 interface evidence (#332); claims no spec row.
methodology_note: Stage 1 of the issue #422 campaign: a coarse 15-value VCTRL scan (0.56-1.12 V, 40 mV steps) per PVT point; the per-corner VCTRL for each graded frequency is interpolated from it (analysis/vctrl-tables.md, tools in sim/vco-2x-iq-scan/analysis/) and re-verified by the graded campaigns, which grade only a point they actually measured inside the frequency band. The quadrature block is reported here for context but is not the graded evidence. 10 fF stand-in load on CLK and CLK90 (assumption).
analysis: transient per swept VCTRL value (`tran 50p 800n uic`) with RESETB released at 60 ns
